name: cloud-security-assessment-pptx
description: PPTX deck generator for the Cloud Security Assessment tool
comment:overrides: image-size <=2.0.2 has DoS CVEs (GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq, GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr). pptxgenjs only requires image-size ^1.2.1, which stays in the vulnerable range, so we force the patched 2.x here. pptxgenjs does not use image-size on the deck-generation path.
